name: MLPerf Inference v4.1 NVIDIA H200-SXM-141GBx8_TRT_MaxQ llama2-70b-99.9 Server run_1 power trace
notes: RAW 1 Hz power trace, same format and same Yokogawa WT333E instrument as the Offline trace, for the SERVER scenario. 3056 samples. CONTRAST WITH THE OFFLINE TRACE IS THE POINT: the Server trace sits near its loaded plateau for essentially the whole window (min 2455.2 W, max 6389.5 W across the post-ramp core) whereas the Offline trace begins at 2406.5 W and takes ~15 minutes to climb to its plateau. Server scenario holds a fixed arrival rate, so power is roughly flat for the whole measurement window; Offline scenario ramps a queue from empty, so early samples are near-idle. Averaging a Server trace without discarding ramp samples, or averaging an Offline trace without discarding ramp samples, are opposite mistakes that both bias joules/token. Downloaded and parsed in full (970,153 bytes).
